title: Comic
description: Comic and dialogue panel UI component for narrative sequences.
content:
Comic

Comic and dialogue panel UI component for displaying narrative sequences and story panels.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"comic": {
  "panels": [],
  "autoAdvance": false,
  "advanceDelay": 0.0
}

Description

The Comic component displays comic-style panels and dialogue sequences in the UI. It supports panel transitions, speech bubbles, and sequential storytelling elements for narrative cutscenes and in-game comic presentations. Panels can be advanced manually by player input or automatically after a configurable delay.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
panelsarrayArray of panel objects defining the comic sequence.
autoAdvanceboolWhether panels advance automatically without player input.
advanceDelayfloatTime in seconds before auto-advancing to the next panel.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "comic": {
      "panels": [
        { "image": "intro_panel_1", "text": "In a world of chaos..." },
        { "image": "intro_panel_2", "text": "One hero rises." }
      ],
      "autoAdvance": false,
      "advanceDelay": 3.0
    }
  }
}
